sources.claude-sonnet-5-5: skill claude-api 2026-10-06: $2 in / $10 out. A copy-model candidate in the Langfuse experiments (2026-10-13).
sources.claude-opus-5-5: skill claude-api 2026-10-06 (per-MTok list prices): $4 in / $20 out. Replaces claude-opus-5 as the generator's copy model (2026-10-13).
sources.claude-opus-4-8: skill claude-api 2026-10-06: $5 in / $25 out. Listed because the copy call opts into server-side fallbacks (`fallbacks: "default"`): a policy decline on claude-opus-5-5 is re-run on claude-opus-5 or claude-opus-4-8, and the served model is what gets priced.
sources.heygen_avatar_iv: HeyGen API pay-as-you-go 2026-09, third-party breakdowns (g2.com, anam.ai); official sheet is behind app.heygen.com/developers/api?modal=pricing. Priced at the HIGHEST avatar type for the engine (digital twin / studio $0.0667/s; photo avatar is $0.05/s) because the adapter does not know the avatar type at pre-flight. 4K deliberately unpriced.
sources.heygen_avatar_iii: Same sources. Priced at the photo-avatar rate ($0.0433/s; digital twin is $0.0167/s), again the conservative side. 4K deliberately unpriced.
sources.heygen_image: developers.heygen.com/docs/enterprise-pricing (read 2026-09-25): Avatar IV photo avatar 0.1 credit/s = $0.05/s; the one-off image mode (`type: image`) runs on Avatar IV. 4K deliberately unpriced.
sources.heygen_prompt_avatar: Avatar creation is 1 credit per call on the same page; the prompt avatar's own price is not listed, so it is priced at 1 credit x $0.50 — the conservative reading.
sources.remotion_selfhost: Founder decision 2026-10-05 (docs/plan-mvp-plantillas-remotion.md §2.3, backlog §0.1): the render service runs in Docker on our own VPS, so a render costs nothing beyond the server; Remotion's Free License applies while the team is 3 people or fewer (remotion.dev/docs/terms, read 2026-10-05). An explicit 0 — the day Automators ($0.01/render, $100/month floor) or Lambda applies, this entry changes, not the code.

sources.dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628: docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/model-pricing (read 2026-10-07; with-video rates read 2026-10-23), online inference. Billed per token: width x height x 24 fps x seconds / 1024 at the output size (estimate); usage.completion_tokens is the real count. Input without video: 480p/720p USD 10.70/M, 1080p 11.7/M. Input WITH video (`*_with_video`): 480p/720p USD 6.40/M, 1080p 7.00/M; the final of a draft takes the rate of its draft. Measured live 2026-10-23 (docs/modelos-generativos/seedance-2-5.md): with video input the billed tokens include the input video (5 s at 480p with one 7.33 s reference video: 115,690 and 118,851 tokens vs ~48k for the output alone). v7 = v6 plus these with-video units.

sources.dola-seedream-5-0-pro-260628: docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/modelark/model-pricing (Last updated: October 23, 2026; read 2026-10-23), online inference, Seedream 5.0 pro. Single-image generation: up to 2.61 million pixels (1.5K or lower) USD 0.045 = per_image_1k; more than 2.61 million pixels (2K) USD 0.09 = per_image_2k. Input images (5.0 pro only): first image free, from the second USD 0.003 = per_extra_reference_image. Layer decomposition (pro only): USD 0.0225 up to 2.61 MP / 0.045 above = per_layer_1k / per_layer_2k; each layer, the base image (z_index 0) included, is billed separately at its actual pixel tier, and if any layer fails the whole request fails. Billing is based only on successfully generated images. API: docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/modelark/image-generation-api (Last updated: October 17, 2026): size 1K, 1.5K or 2K; layer_decomposition needs exactly one input image. Added for the m-24849234 eval, which selects v6 explicitly; deliberately NO per_piece unit, so the production router refuses this model until a release prices it there on purpose.
sources.dola-seedream-5-0-flash-260915: Same pricing page (read 2026-10-23): Seedream 5.0 flash USD 0.018 per generated image at every size, input images free. Layer decomposition is offered by the API but left unpriced here on purpose (not read on the sheet): a quote for it must fail.
